line: I kept telling myself love meant staying, even when I disappeared.
prompt: A 25-year-old woman with a medium build, shoulder-length dark curly hair, warm brown skin, and an oval face sits upright on a beige sofa in a small apartment living room. She wears a soft cream cardigan over a plain white top and a thin gold necklace. Behind her are a wooden side table with a ceramic lamp, a framed abstract print, and a leafy houseplant near a curtained window. Warm afternoon light fills the room, with soft shadows and a shallow depth of field. The camera is locked in a steady medium close-up at eye level, centered on her face and shoulders, documentary-style, as she looks directly into the lens. She speaks directly to camera, quiet, guarded honesty: "I kept telling myself love meant staying, even when I disappeared." Natural lip sync to dialogue, no background music, no score.
